Revenue.custom_check_code:
def custom_check(series: pd.Series) -> dict:
    import re
    total=len(series)
    pattern=re.compile(r'[\$\,kKmM]')
    violations=sum(bool(pattern.search(str(v))) for v in series)
    passed=violations==0
    metric=f'{violations} / {total} violations' if not passed else '0 violations'
    details='Non-numeric characters found in {} out of {} values'.format(violations,total) if not passed else 'All values conform to quality constraint'
    return {'passed':passed,'metric':metric,'details':details}
